That is the workspace terminal — chart, drawings, screener, algos and the trade tables, gated by the modules this account is granted. Your own Client Home dashboard already embeds it; this line is for embedding it anywhere else.

userToken is per-trader and short-lived. Your Client Home mints it automatically for whoever is logged in (POST …/home/api/auth/chart-token), so the dashboard needs nothing from you. To open the workspace as a specific trader yourself — to check the install, or to embed it on another page of your own site — use Members → Chart link, which mints one and copies the whole URL. It signs you in as that trader, so treat it like their password.
